notes.title: 2023/4/14 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]

[list][*]Added messages from the voice actors to the English and Chinese versions. These messages can be accessed from the title screen after clearing the game.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause battles not to conclude properly under certain circumstances.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause some doors to be impassable even when opened.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the following ABLs to take effect before they were activated:
[list]
[*]Extravagant Experience
[*]Mo' Money
[*]Paid in Experience
[*]Employee Benefits[/list][*]Fixed an issue that could cause characters to become invisible during events.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause resource points and enemies not to appear correctly upon loading.
[*]Fixed some typos in the text.
[*]Various minor fixes and adjustments.[/list]

notes.title: 1/23 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]

[list][*]Added basic mouse controls for camera movement and the Confirm/Cancel actions
[*]Added new vertical synchronization options to address screen tearing issues[/list]

notes.title: 12/21 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]

[list][*]Adjusted player movement speed
[*]Improved townsperson NPC visuals
[*]Adjusted monster balance
[*]Modified area maps
[*]Modified tutorial sections
[*]Made some Nuko Shrine functionality available anywhere from the System Menu
[*]The System Menu is now accessible directly from the field instead of from the Camp Menu
[*]Various minor fixes and adjustments[/list]

notes.title: 12/2 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]

[list][*]Adjusted monster balance in the early game.
[*]Adjusted the Dash Gauge and some equipment.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause the game to become unresponsive while interacting with the expanded map.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause temporary NPC allies to remain in the party after they should have left.
[*]Fixed some issues with the English and Chinese translations.[/list]

notes.title: 11/28 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]

[list][*]Fixed an issue with the previous version that prevented players from obtaining Steam achievements.
[*]Players who earned achievement on the previous version of the game can now obtain them.
[*]Fixed an issue that sometimes caused dialogue not to be displayed.
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented players from selecting a difficulty option with certain hardware configurations.
[*]Fixed some issues with the English and Chinese translations.
[*]Fixed an issue that could sometimes cause players to fall through the floor after jumping off ledges.[/list]

notes.title: 11/23 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed an issue with the previous version that caused some scenario lines in the English version to display in Japanese.[/list]

notes.title: 11/21 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed an issue with English and Chinese translations in the Music Player.[/list]

notes.title: 11/18 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed an issue that could previously block progress during certain battles in Chapter 7.
[*]Updated the file structure of the Chinese version to reduce space usage.[/list]
